simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to בָּשַׁס (H1318) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: בָּשַׁס (bâshaç) means to trample down First listed occurrence: Amos 5 11.

definitions.full: H1318. bashas [ בשׁס ] verb Po`el Infinitive suffix בּוֺשַׁסְכֶם Amos 5:11 probably your trampling (by dissimilation from בּוּס ) followed by עַל . בּשֶׁת see below בושׁ .
